Kiseki (Casual) walks in

■Stage Directions
1 second of silence at the start

"We currently have a few spots remaining!
If you would like to participate, please head to the reception booth next to the main stage—"

I'm sure it would've been fun even if I joined alone, but...
Because I was with you! It turned into an experience far beyond anything I could have imagined!

And now, give us a line!
Your signature catchphrase!

...Wait, of course you can!! —Yay!
You're interested in cosplay too, Trainer?!

......Gaaah!
That was so much fuuun!!!

"I want to express this love through something!" Maybe cosplay is
one of the ways that leads to. Standing on that stage made me feel that way.

The buddy chemistry with you cosplaying 'Larky' was top-tier too!
I really feel like these two are the ones destined to take down the ultimate assassin!
Yes!!
To draw amazing manga!!

"It's my life.
I'll spend it however I damn well please."

Hehe. Let's cosplay together again sometime!
Next time, even at the academy!

I felt a bit bashful, but accepted Kiseki's praise.
Even in my line of work, I'd never had the chance to wear such a flashy suit.

Her sheer enthusiasm rendered me momentarily silent. Just like when
she was doing research for her manga before, Kiseki's dedication to creating was truly sincere—

Yeah, it's a rare opportunity.
If there's a chance, we've gotta dive right in!

Hehe, no good, huh? In that case,
I need to record you looking like this while I still can!

Ooooh! Both of you look so sharp in those stylish suits,
the spitting image of the story's notorious duo—the 'Bloody Combo'!

"Did you call your mommy to say goodbye?
If not, you better make it quick."

"Costumes and props will be provided, so please come on down!
Why not step onto the stage as your favorite character?"

If I experience cosplay today, I'm sure it'll come in handy
when I draw a character who loves cosplay, right?

The thought crossed my mind naturally,
and before I knew it, I was making a suggestion to Kiseki.

...Yes! You're totally right!
In that case, let's go with the one that's super hot right now—

It's Yagippy from 'Cobalt Seekers'!
Heyyy! Yagippy!! I'm a huge fan! Take a photo with meee!!

Deciding on characters, signature poses, discussing which lines to use...
Every single moment we spent doing that together was so much fun.

Ehehe. It really feels like we're inside the world of 'Pale Gang'!
...Oh, I know! Trainer, let's reenact that scene!

I could also give Kiseki the experience of "participating together."
If it could become fuel for her creative spirit, there was no reason not to join.

Sensei Shishizaki's original manuscript... it was practically glowing, seriously...!!
Not just the character linework. Every single action line was so intricate, so delicate—

...No, wait. Is that it?
I mean, that's part of it, but...

As expected, on days with 'fun experiences,' creative inspiration just wells right up!
And that's all thanks to the Manga Expo—
Trainer... you went that far...

Is that so? Then from now on,
you totally have permission to wear that to work!

Waaah! Look at that, Trainer!!
Over there! That!
Then we've gotta give it a shot first!
To the long-awaited Manga Expo!

I figured that by participating in the cosplay workshop myself, I could
give her my own personal perspective on the experience. On top of that—

I gave a small shake of my head at Kiseki's words.
The reason I wanted to participate wasn't that—

Yes! Because... to output an interesting story,
I need to build up a "storehouse" of experiences myself!

There wasn't a hint of hesitation. You could see the finished art right from the storyboard stage...
...Gaaah!! I want to draw like that too, so badly!!

...I think I finally understand how cosplayers feel.
At the core, there's pure love for the character—and this is what happens when it overflows.

"Attention, attendees! Starting today at 4:00 PM,
we will be hosting a Character Cosplay Experience on the main stage!"

—Alright.
I'm going to participate!

Ah! That was Kiseki
and her Trainer! Let's give them a huge round of applause!!

...Hehe. Allllright, let's do this!
Let's pull off the most amazing cosplay that'll glue everyone's eyes to us!!

Ehehe! Do I give off the vibe of assassin Rank 7?
I really love this character, you know! They've got such a solid aesthetic!
I'd love to go again, together.

I mean, you too, Trainer... wow! You look amazing, it really suits you!
A suit really does look best when worn by an adult!

Come on, come on, Trainer!
Let's head over so fast speed lines trail behind us!

...Hmm, I see. Yagippy's fur is a lot coarser than I thought.
Is that official lore? Or just this costume?

Today, having received some spare tickets,
I went to the Manga Expo with Kiseki.
This is insssssssaaaaane...!!!!

Uwaaah, what should I do?! Cosplaying 'The Profligate Blade' would be awesome too!
I'd love to wear a kimono... but when it comes to character love...!

After making our way through all the exhibits,
we took a short break at the attached café—

....................................Hah!
Whoa, I'm totally in the zone! Am I a genius or what~~~?!

Ta-da! How do I look?!
I'm 'Keera' from 'Guns & Gunpowder'!

"—I'll go.
You guys sit tight and hug your knees right here."

Amaaazing! This backdrop is crafted so meticulously!
You can tell even the way the cloudy sky is drawn matches the original manga's screentones!

Our next participants enter as a duo!
It's 'Keera' and 'Larky' from 'Guns & Gunpowder'!

Man oh maaan, Trainer!
That was so much fun! It made for such a great experience!
......Ahaha.
"Can I join in on that too?"
"Can I join in on that too?"
